product_universe.qa_exception_policy: retain all frozen_primary_with_qa_exception in main analysis; exclude only in predeclared sensitivity R1

image_exposure_policy.sensitivity_exposure: frozen sensitivity exposure only when sensitivity_status == available
image_exposure_policy.excluded_non_primary: never reenters main image modeling via fallback or sensitivity exposure

label_semantics.one: observed spontaneous consumer mention / observed positive

dimension_fdr.family: eligible core dimension outcomes derived from dimension_keep_core == 1

g_policy.grid_policy: report all pre-existing frozen diagnostics; do not select a performance-best threshold or invent a new cutoff

allowed: deterministic features derived only from frozen image bytes

allowed_feature_families.primary: pretrained image-only/image-encoder embedding, e.g. a frozen CLIP visual encoder family
allowed_feature_families.representation_robustness: one predeclared vision-only pretrained embedding family
allowed_feature_families.interpretable_baseline: small deterministic global color/luminance/contrast, edge/texture, and composition/layout summaries
allowed_feature_families.exact_extraction_schema: must be frozen in P9 before extraction

modeling_boundary.primary_benchmark: regularized linear model on frozen image representation
modeling_boundary.nonlinear_robustness: one predeclared family on the same frozen features

split_policy.duplicate_group_rule: all products sharing an exact primary response SHA remain in one split

stratification_objective.formula: abs(row deviation) / total rows + abs(observed-positive deviation) / total observed positives
stratification_objective.locked_test_target: 20% of full-universe rows and 20% of full-universe observed positives
stratification_objective.development_fold_target: 20% of post-locked-test development rows and 20% of post-locked-test development observed positives
stratification_objective.comparison: minimum joint scalar loss; SHA is used only for deterministic ordering and ties

locked_test_algorithm.candidate_evaluation: evaluate every candidate whole group assignment using the joint loss
steps: Aggregate each primary_response_sha256 group into product_count and observed_positive_count.
Set locked-test row and observed-positive targets to 20% of full-universe totals.
From the current selected set, evaluate every remaining whole group candidate with the joint scalar loss.
Add the candidate with minimum loss only when it strictly improves the current loss; use SHA256(p8b_split_v1 + group key) and group key only for deterministic ties.
Stop when no remaining whole group improves the loss; assign all unselected groups to development and report both realized deviations.
locked_test_algorithm.objective: minimum joint scalar loss with equal row and observed-positive weights
locked_test_algorithm.group_integrity: each whole group receives exactly one assignment
locked_test_algorithm.selection_rule: no model performance, test-set tuning, seed changes, or favorable-split retry

development_five_fold_algorithm.input_universe: groups assigned to development after locked-test partition only
development_five_fold_algorithm.candidate_evaluation: evaluate every candidate fold by the aggregate joint loss across all five folds after assignment
steps: Consume only groups assigned to development by the locked-test algorithm.
Set each fold target to 20% of post-locked-test development rows and observed positives.
Process development groups in SHA256(p8b_split_v1 + group key) order.

For each group, evaluate all five whole-fold candidates by the aggregate equal-weight row plus observed-positive loss across all five folds after each tentative assignment; assign the minimum global loss; use fold index only for exact global-loss ties.
Report per-fold realized row and observed-positive counts and deviations from development-based targets.
development_five_fold_algorithm.objective: minimum aggregate global joint scalar loss across all five folds with equal row and observed-positive weights
development_five_fold_algorithm.group_integrity: each development group receives exactly one fold
development_five_fold_algorithm.selection_rule: no model performance, test-set tuning, seed changes, or favorable-split retry
development_five_fold_algorithm.global_loss: sum of joint_balance_loss across all five folds after each tentative assignment

split_policy.future_assignment_algorithm: deterministic group-aware approximate stratification using a fixed joint row and observed-positive balancing loss; SHA is ordering/tie-break only

metrics: lift/enrichment relative to observed-positive base rate
evaluation_policy.calibration_interpretation: calibration to the observed-positive indicator only

sensitivity_analyses.R1: known-QA-exception exclusion sensitivity; exclude only the 83 known P7-C exceptions
sensitivity_analyses.R2: alternative image exposure sensitivity; compare primary vs frozen sensitivity exposure for 14 available products without changing split grouping
sensitivity_analyses.R3: G quality/exposure sensitivity; report all existing frozen grid/rules or continuous diagnostic
sensitivity_analyses.R4: label-definition robustness; compare core vs pilot/robust variants without promotion
sensitivity_analyses.R5: known placeholder/image-exception subgroup descriptive score behavior

forbidden_adaptations: treating PU zero as confirmed negative
p8_b_requirements: materialize modeling-ready manifest from frozen primary exposure
freeze deterministic group-aware split with p8b_split_v1
do not use test set during development decisions
retain sensitivity specifications from this contract

formal_output_policy.provenance_uses: Git blob bytes for tracked producer, contract, and tracked dependencies
